svg.title: Household Assistant budget period navigation mockups
svg.desc: A responsive decision board showing independent weekly and monthly history navigation. Mobile states demonstrate current periods, a previous week with the month unchanged, and a previous month with the week unchanged. A desktop view groups budget lines by cadence with separate navigators.
svg.text: Budget history · each cadence moves on its own
Weekly and monthly lines stay visible together, but their period cursors never drag each other through time.

g.text: Trains, buses, taxis, and IC top-ups
A weekly arrow changes only the weekly query anchor; a monthly arrow changes only the monthly anchor.
Until cap revisions exist, historical differences are always labelled against the current cap.
